nodes.label: AGENT.md — Physics Verification & UI Sync Rules
nodes.rationale: Mandates Rule 17 classification (no magic numbers; empirical params exposed via GENESIS_ env vars), Rule 13 substrate grounding (metabolic cost scales with organism footprint), evolution speedups only via code optimization not physics tuning, no hardcoded absolute paths, and atomic frontend/backend co-update so UI never mocks live engine state.

nodes.label: AGENTS.md — Workspace Rules 22-24 & Architecture Index
nodes.rationale: Locks Exp 91 validated optimal substrate baseline (Z_Pop=+25.72 sigma) as default for all future drivers; UI is Observer Mode only (sliders locked) so user monitors rather than tunes; FP16 tensor cores on Turing T4 unlock 65 vs 8.1 TFLOPS; claim boundary CERTIFIED_LEVEL_1 with AGI_CLAIM NOT_SUPPORTED.

nodes.label: Rule 22: Autonomous Observer Baseline
nodes.rationale: Exp 91 config (INCOME_FOOTPRINT=1, AUTO_REPRO=1, REMAP=1, CAM=0 to eliminate 736 cycles/tick scan tax, MULTISCALE=1, STDP3C=1) is empirically verified optimal; UI locked to observer mode to prevent manual tuning from contaminating evolved behavior.

nodes.label: Rule 23: PyTorch FP16 Tensor Core Optimization
nodes.rationale: Turing T4 tensor cores require float16 casts; zero-allocation broadcasts via .view()+.unsqueeze() avoid dynamic VRAM allocation overhead inside time loops.

nodes.label: Rule 24: Level 1 Replication Certification
nodes.rationale: 5 task families (DMTS, Bit Parity, Compositional Arithmetic, Spatial Navigation, Causal Intervention) evaluated across Series 1200 seeds 1201-1210 in fresh processes with zero base weight drift; strict claim boundary prevents overclaiming AGI.

nodes.label: GENESIS Rules 1-8
nodes.rationale: Binding rules: doc sync, pre-registered falsification, 5+ seed replication, mandatory skepticism, proto-cognitive ancestor boundary (no authored reasoning in ancestor), prime directive of open-ended intelligence, emergent efficiency via honest substrate accounting, provenance/directory integrity.

nodes.label: Rule 1: Context and Documentation Sync
nodes.rationale: Read Docs/ before implementation; update authoritative docs after changes; mark superseded material historical.

nodes.label: Rule 2: Pre-register Falsification
nodes.rationale: Quantitative binding falsification criterion archived before each experiment; failed criterion invalidates claim and must never be ignored post-hoc.

nodes.label: Rule 3: Reproduce Across Seeds
nodes.rationale: Single-seed findings are preliminary; quantitative claims need >=5 independent seeds with mean, std, delta, z-score.

nodes.label: Rule 5: Proto-cognitive Ancestor Boundary
nodes.rationale: Ancestor may contain only minimal survival primitives (sensing, energy, homeostasis, plasticity, replication, failure response); no authored reasoning/planning/human knowledge; diagnostic oracle code is not organism capability.

nodes.label: Rule 7: Emergent Efficiency
nodes.rationale: Selection must arise from honest substrate resource accounting, never authored IQ scores; observation metrics must not control survival/reproduction/ranking.

nodes.label: GENESIS Rules 9-16
nodes.rationale: Binding rules: autotelic imperative (no human-authored puzzles), diagnostic exclusion clause, biological computation as hypothesis, scientific record in Article_Draft.md, open-endedness with grounded contention, population stability/refugium disclosure, substrate-grounded abstraction, death/extinction/bounded rescue.

nodes.label: Rule 9: Autotelic Imperative
nodes.rationale: Final environment must not depend on human-authored puzzles/curricula/language; selection from substrate consequences; observation strictly separate from selection.

nodes.label: Rule 10: Diagnostic Exclusion Clause
nodes.rationale: Diagnostic curriculum may isolate substrate capacity only if artificial nature declared and it does not encode the answer; positive diagnostic remains pending until reproduced autotelically.

nodes.label: Rule 14: Population Stability and Refugium Disclosure
nodes.rationale: No top-down ratchet; Ark/refugium is emergency bounded backstop; refugium use above 5% of ticks means life support and requires survivorship-confound disclosure.

nodes.label: GENESIS Rules 17-21
nodes.rationale: Binding rules: no arbitrary selection-relevant constants (H/E/O classification), falsifiable finish line (25% capability rise over 5M ticks, beat learning-ablation control, C/footprint non-decreasing), memory capacity/dynamic compact RAM, shortcut accountability with NULL controls, physical grounding (no game mechanics).

nodes.label: Rule 17: No Arbitrary Selection-Relevant Constants
nodes.rationale: Every value classified as hardware-derived (H), evolvable/DNA-encoded (E), structural bound, mathematical invariant, empirical model parameter, or ISA opcode (O); never silently tune.

nodes.label: Rule 18: Falsifiable Finish Line
nodes.rationale: Binding finish line: capability C(t) rises >=25% monotone over >=5M ticks without baseline regression; learning beats matched ablation control; C/footprint non-decreasing; metrics observation-only.

nodes.label: Rule 19: Memory Capacity and Dynamic RAM
nodes.rationale: CAM config recorded in every dependent experiment; dynamic compact RAM live_size = book_bytes + alive_organisms, no blank cells, reallocates only between kernel ticks.

nodes.label: Rule 20: Shortcut Accountability
nodes.rationale: Every positive cognitive claim requires format- and marginal-matched NULL controls, replication, claim-control delta; oracle probes are diagnostics never organism capability.

nodes.label: Rule 21: Physical Grounding — No Game Mechanics
nodes.rationale: Costs charge measured host work (CPU/GPU cycles, RAM traffic, joules); parameters H-derived or E-encoded; tuning test: if a number works because a designer searched for it, it is illegal; income grounded in measured work freed; capacity derived at runtime from cgroup memory; evolvable constants are genome records; Numba discipline with preallocated typed arrays.

nodes.label: cavecrew — Subagent Delegation Decision Guide
nodes.rationale: Caveman subagent tool-results inject back into main context verbatim at ~1/3 the size of vanilla prose; across 20 delegations this is the difference between context exhaustion and finishing the task.

nodes.label: cavecrew-investigator Subagent
nodes.rationale: Read-only code location agent; returns site list path:line — symbol — note; pinned to haiku model by default.

nodes.label: cavecrew-builder Subagent
nodes.rationale: Surgical edit agent for 1-2 files; refuses 3+ file scope; no model pin (uses session default).

nodes.label: cavecrew-reviewer Subagent
nodes.rationale: Diff/file review agent emitting one-line findings with severity emoji; pinned to haiku model by default.

nodes.label: caveman-commit — Terse Conventional Commits
nodes.rationale: Subject <=50 chars hard cap 72, imperative mood, body only when why is non-obvious; body always required for breaking changes/security/migrations/reverts because future debuggers need the context; no AI attribution.

nodes.label: caveman-compress — Memory File Compression
nodes.rationale: CLAUDE.md loads on every session start; compressing project memory files to caveman format saves ~46% tokens on average (measured 898->481) every single session; original preserved as .original.md; only compression and targeted fixes use tokens, validation is local Python.

nodes.label: caveman-help — Quick Reference Card
nodes.rationale: One-shot cheat sheet of caveman modes/skills/deactivation triggers; does not flip active mode or persist anything.

nodes.label: caveman-review — One-line PR Comments
nodes.rationale: Format L<line>: <severity> <problem>. <fix>.; drops hedging; auto-clarity drops terse mode for CVE-class security findings and architectural disagreements where author needs the why.

nodes.label: caveman-stats — Real Session Token Receipts
nodes.rationale: Reads Claude Code session JSONL log directly for actual token usage; no AI estimation; caveman-mode-tracker hook intercepts /caveman-stats and returns formatted stats as blocked-decision reason.

nodes.label: caveman — Compressed Response Mode
nodes.rationale: Compresses model responses to caveman prose cutting 65% of output tokens (measured) with full technical accuracy; six intensity levels lite/full/ultra/wenyan-lite/wenyan-full/wenyan-ultra; auto-clarity rule drops to normal prose for security warnings and irreversible-action confirmations.

nodes.label: CAMDIAG24 — CAM Diagnostic Memory Dump (24)
nodes.rationale: Raw CAM (content-addressable memory) diagnostic dump: encoded cell entries of form xaaaaaY used to verify CAM storage/routing behavior under Rule 19/20 diagnostics.

nodes.label: CAMDIAG_RULE — CAM Diagnostic Dump (Rule Arm)
nodes.rationale: CAM diagnostic dump for the RULE experimental arm; paired with CAMDIAG24 to compare CAM content under rule-conditioned vs baseline conditions.

nodes.label: DelayedMatch — DMTS Cue/Answer Diagnostic Sequence
nodes.rationale: Delayed Match-To-Sample (Task 1 DMTS) diagnostic data: [cue:a/b]...[ans:A/B] pairs with delay dots; tests working memory retention across a delay — the substrate must hold cue identity to answer correctly.
